svg.title: Container Diagram (C4 Level 2) - FlowGuard Telemetry Engine

g.text: Container Diagram (C4 Level 2) - FlowGuard Telemetry Engine
API client suite providing operational views
Stores users, plant sectors, conveyor lines,
sensor nodes, threshold rules, enriched telemetry,
anomaly alerts, spare-part stock, and CQRS SQL Views.
Monitors line health and acknowledges alerts
Manages topology, threshold rules, and spare parts
Manages user accounts and security roles
Consumes REST API (/api/v1/*) with Bearer JWT
Dispatches transactional outbox alert webhooks (Roadmap Task 3)
Reads and writes via native PostgreSQL pool (pg) with ACID locks & ON DELETE RESTRICT
